  InternalS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref InternalS3BucketName
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref InternalS3BucketName
        - Key: cluster
          Value: !Ref ClusterName
  S3StratioAppsIAMUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref InternalS3BucketUser
      Tags:
        - Key: cluster
          Value: !Ref ClusterName
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "s3-stratio-apps"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action: "s3:ListAllMyBuckets"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action: "s3:*"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${InternalS3BucketName}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${InternalS3BucketName}/*"
              - Effect: "Deny"
                NotAction: "s3:*"
                NotResource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${InternalS3BucketName}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${InternalS3BucketName}/*"
  S3StratioAppsIAMUserAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      Status: Active
      UserName: !Ref S3StratioAppsIAMUser
  S3StratioAppsSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref InternalS3BucketUser
      Description: !Sub "Access and secret key for IAM user ${InternalS3BucketUser}"
      Tags:
        - Key: cluster
          Value: !Ref ClusterName
      SecretString: !Sub '{"ACCESS_KEY":"${S3StratioAppsIAMUserAccessKey}","SECRET_KEY":"${S3StratioAppsIAMUserAccessKey.SecretAccessKey}"}'
